copy.tagline: 优化联盟项目以提升佣金和防欺诈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在运营联盟计划，需要提升效果并控制风险
copy.tagline_en: Optimize affiliate programs for improved commission and fraud prevention
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are running an affiliate program and need to improve performance and mitigate risks

howto.what: 当用户提出联盟营销相关需求时，Claude 会提供从项目设计、合作伙伴评分、佣金经济、追踪质量、欺诈控制和合规审查的全流程支持，包括准备招募材料、处理归属冲突、生成报告等。
howto.when: 当用户需要联盟营销、联盟项目管理、合作伙伴招募、追踪或运营等帮助时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个电商联盟项目的佣金结构。
say.note: Claude 会基于利润率和转化率给出佣金建议。

say.text: 审查这个社交媒体合作伙伴的欺诈风险。
say.note: Claude 会检查自荐、流量质量等欺诈信号。

say.text: 为我们的联盟追踪链接做QA检查。
say.note: Claude 会验证链接映射、归因逻辑和UTM命名。

howto.what_en: When the user has affiliate marketing needs, Claude provides end-to-end support for program design, partner scoring, commission economics, tracking QA, fraud controls, and compliance reviews, including outreach pack preparation, attribution conflict handling, and report generation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs help with affiliate marketing, affiliate program management, partner recruitment, tracking, or operations.

say_en.text: Design a commission structure for my ecommerce affiliate program.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend commission based on margin and conversion rates.

say_en.text: Review this social media partner for fraud risks.
say_en.note: Claude will check for self-referrals, traffic quality, etc.
Claude will validate link mapping, attribution logic, and UTM naming.
